# Bootstrap the FastAPI application and health probe

Stands up the FastAPI app, wires configuration, and exposes `GET /healthz` so a
deployment can tell the process is alive before any real traffic arrives.

## Deliverables

- `create_app()` factory returning a configured `FastAPI` instance.
- `GET /healthz` → `{ "ok": true, "version": "<pkg version>" }`.
- Settings loaded from the environment with sane local defaults.

## Health contract

| Field     | Type   | Meaning                    |
| --------- | ------ | -------------------------- |
| `ok`      | bool   | always `true` when serving |
| `version` | string | package version string     |

## Reference

```python
from snip.app import create_app

app = create_app()

@app.get("/healthz")
def healthz():
    return {"ok": True, "version": __version__}
```

The probe stays dependency-free so it answers even when the datastore is down[^probe].

[^probe]: A health check that touches the database turns a slow query into a false
    "process dead" signal; liveness and readiness are kept separate.
